name: Inkling REL
tagline: Full-context, content-dependent relative position bias in the shared Dense shell.
description: An independent adaptation of Inkling relative logits: a per-query 16-dimensional projection and a layer-local distance table shared across heads produce a content-dependent bias for every causal distance 0 through 2047. Replaces RoPE while retaining shared parameter-free QK normalization, gain, attention scaling, value embeddings and optimizer. A differentiable CPU reference and original Triton forward/backward implement the same function.
mechanism: Query/head-specific relative vector, d_rel = 16; a trainable distance table is shared across heads within each layer
Covers all backward distances 0–2047, including self; no RoPE or clipped distance region
Original Triton forward/backward, FP32 softmax accumulators, full-sequence MHA
limitations: Single seed 42; fixed-compute mechanism adaptation, not the source model's complete training recipe. CORE left truncation removes BOS and affects SQuAD interpretation; only original protocol scores are published. The 64-rank execution layout is registered in the run audit. REL supports full-sequence training/evaluation, not incremental KV-cache decoding.
